guarantees.statement: Entries per MemoryCluster never exceed the declared budget.
Entries per transient cluster never exceed the declared budget.
Live MemoryCluster count never exceeds the declared budget.
guarantees.witness: lib.rs::add_to_dejavu_db evicts the coldest cluster at capacity

guarantees.statement: Live transient cluster count never exceeds the declared budget.
guarantees.witness: lib.rs::add_transient_fact freezes/evicts the coldest transient at capacity

guarantees.statement: Resident memory accounting includes entries, metadata, accumulators, indexes, and conversation state.
guarantees.witness: reliability::account_brain / account_conversation; enforced budget via MemoryReport::within_budget

guarantees.statement: Every replay check is classified as hash consistency, recomputation, or independent verification.
HTTP request bodies and turn text are bounded.
A turn has a bounded execution time; exceeding it yields an explicit timeout outcome.
Concurrent in-flight turns are bounded by admission control.
Cancellation is observed between processing stages and reported truthfully.
guarantees.configuration: cooperative; a single long solver call is not preemptible

guarantees.statement: A background task executes a capability only if it is inside the task's declared authority scope, and only while inside its declared resource budget; otherwise the task is stopped (refused) before the capability runs.
guarantees.witness: autonomy_task::TaskRunner::step checks scope and budget before invoking the host adapter; a breach yields TaskState::Refused
guarantees.configuration: applies to the five bounded task kinds; no kind can declare shell, network, or simulation authority

guarantees.statement: Every task step is recorded as an ordered progress entry, and every task can explain its result, its stop reason, and whether it stayed within its declaration.
guarantees.witness: autonomy_task::TaskRunner::step appends TaskProgress; TaskReport::from_task renders the explanation

guarantees.statement: The health endpoint answers without waiting indefinitely behind a CPU-heavy turn.
guarantees.witness: chat_server::health polls try_lock with a 200 ms budget and falls back to cached counts

guarantees.statement: The HTTP service binds loopback by default and refuses non-loopback binds without explicit opt-in.
A non-loopback bind requires a bearer token.
guarantees.configuration: applies when binding a non-loopback address

guarantees.statement: Projection telemetry measures the configured runtime path, not a hardcoded backend.
guarantees.witness: reliability::projection_path; lib.rs::measure_kappa_p records the active ProjectionPath
guarantees.configuration: CUDA backend unavailable in this build; path reports cpu_soft_projection

guarantees.statement: A database is never opened for migration without a pre-upgrade backup, and a database newer than the running build is refused rather than misread.
guarantees.witness: operator::run_upgrade backs up before opening the service; persistence::db::Database::open refuses a newer PRAGMA user_version; operator::plan_upgrade reports incompatible before any write
guarantees.configuration: applies to the operator upgrade path and to any service open
